questions: The backoff step logic has changed: original checks `ms >= J2534_BACKOFF_CAP_MS / 2` (>=2500), new code checks `backoff_ms < J2534_BACKOFF_CAP_MS` (<5000). These are not equivalent - the new code allows values from 2501-4999 to be doubled (5002-9998, clamped to 5000) whereas the original would have returned 5000 directly. Is this behavioral change intentional?
